title: Trust Finance
tagline: Tools for DAO contributors and freelancers to optimize income and get access to benefits on-chain
description:
We have built a product that enables DAOs and DAO contributors to easily manage payment and also optimize earnings on the chain. Several DAO members have highlighted the need for them to earn a yield on their income in real-time.Additionally, DAO do not provide benefits products that allows the to attract and retain talents. 
Trust Finance has developed three key features that will allow the next billion users in crypto to earn and get access to benefits.
Earn and Stake: The earn and stake features provides DAO contributors the ability to stream their income in real time to an investment or yield generating position. We leveraged Superfluid and existing platforms such as Aave to ensure contributors harness the time value of money
Benefits: The feature enables DAO to offer the devoted core members and contributors to have access to additional benefits apart from money benefits. The provides a tool for DAO to attract top talents that are committed to contribute long term. They have access to dividend payout, matching benefits, and token equity.
Rewards: DAO can provide NFT and loyalty token to incentive contributors to work on task or engage on discord and social media.
how_its_made:
We have utilized several technologies for the product.  Front End: We utilized wallet connect and build a simple web app front end. 
Smart Contract: We build a smart contract that implemented superfluid and Aave. We deployed the smart contracts on the polygon. We are using Chainlink keepers for automation within the smart contract.
